notes: Gojo's kits (v9.9). Slot 0, Hollow Purple, is a technique: his look stays, the kit clips show red and blue cursed energy. Slot 1, the Six Eyes, changes the look: the blindfold comes off (guard picture w1guard), so every state is generated too, from his own state prompts. Orbs, bursts and the teleport are drawn by the game; Purple and both ultimates keep their clips.

w0_jab: first hit of a fast three-hit combo: a quick straight punch, a ripple of blue cursed energy at his fist, then back into the stance
w0_jab2: second hit: a fast high kick at head height, a thin trail of blue cursed energy following his foot, then back into the stance
w0_jab3: finisher: thrusts his open palm forward at full arm extension, a burst of red cursed energy blasting from the palm, then back into the stance
w0_nair: air combo: a spinning kick in mid-air, then a second spinning kick the other way, thin trails of blue cursed energy, then back to the tucked pose
w0_sspecial: Reversal Red: raises two fingers in front of him, a small bright red glow at his fingertips, then thrusts them forward hard with a strong recoil, then back into the stance. Only Gojo is drawn: no blast flying away
w0_uspecial: Blue lift: points one finger straight up above his head and rises straight up into the air, his uniform fluttering, a faint blue glow at his fingertip, rising the whole time
w0_dspecial: focus burst: brings both hands together in front of his chest, focusing, braces, then throws both arms wide as if releasing a burst of power, then back into the stance. Only Gojo is drawn: no effect

1.wguard: he pulls the black blindfold off his face with one hand and lets it fall, revealing his bright glowing blue eyes, his spiky white hair staying up, then settles into the relaxed stance, one hand raised with the index and middle fingers up
1.subject: Satoru Gojo from Jujutsu Kaisen, a tall man with spiky white hair and bright glowing blue eyes (no blindfold), a dark navy high-collared uniform
1.guard_pose: relaxed upright stance facing right, one hand raised in front of his chest with the index and middle fingers up, the other arm hanging loose, his bright blue eyes uncovered
1.air_pose: in mid-air facing right, knees tucked, his bright blue eyes uncovered

w1_jab: first hit of a lightning-fast combo, his blue eyes glowing: a quick straight punch, a flash of blue cursed energy at his fist, then back into the stance
w1_jab2: second hit: a fast spinning back kick at chest height, a thin trail of blue cursed energy, then back into the stance
w1_jab3: finisher: thrusts two fingers forward and a big burst of red cursed energy explodes at his fingertips, then back into the stance
w1_nair: air combo: spins in mid-air with two fast kicks, thin trails of blue cursed energy, then back to the tucked pose
w1_nspecial: Maximum Red: raises two fingers, a bright red glow growing at his fingertips, then flicks them forward, then back into the stance. Only Gojo is drawn: no orb flying away
w1_sspecial: Maximum Blue: holds one hand forward with the fingers spread, a swirling blue glow forming in front of his palm, then pushes it forward, then back into the stance. Only Gojo is drawn: no orb flying away
w1_uspecial: instant teleport: crosses two fingers in front of his face, his body flickering and fading out, then flickering back in, then back into the stance. Only Gojo is drawn: no effect
w1_dspecial: Infinity: stands perfectly still with one hand raised, palm out, his blue eyes glowing, calm and untouchable, then flicks his fingers forward, then back into the stance. Only Gojo is drawn: no effect
